title: Triage NHS score-fix intake rows into real leads, paid fulfillment, and test cleanup
acceptance_criteria: Read /api/v1/admin/geo-jobs with the NHS admin Bearer token using inline Keychain access and do not print emails, payment ids, or notes.
Create an ops ledger summarizing rows by status and host class, separating obvious test rows from real paid or lead-mode requests.
For any real paid or lead-mode row, create a separate public-gated fulfillment or customer-follow-up WorkItem instead of sending from the planner.
Add or document a cleanup path for stale test rows so the score-fix conversion surface can be monitored without noisy pending rows.

title: Make the daily NHS recrawl health-aware and non-disruptive
source_ref: tools/health-guard.log:2026-05-07T10:50-11:21Z api_status=000 during same morning as tools/recrawl.log full crawl success=9708 failed=483
acceptance_criteria: Inspect the launchd recrawl wrapper and app health guard to confirm whether the 2026-05-07 API brownout overlapped the full recrawl window.
Add a run lock, health preflight, and skip-or-throttle behavior so a recrawl does not continue at full pressure while the public API is unavailable.
Prefer bounded verification such as a small file crawl or recategorize-only smoke; do not trigger a full manual recrawl.
Record recrawl start, skip, throttle, completion, and health outcome lines in a durable log that the planner can read next run.
